## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build` if extension code changed
- [ ] Chrome or Edge manual QA if runtime behavior or UI changed

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request has one focused purpose
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] Screenshots or a recording are included for visible UI changes
- [ ] No secrets or private WebSocket payloads are included
